title: St Nicholas Workshop for Kids
deck: Advent crafts, the story of St Nick, and the enthronement of our new Child Bishop.
body:
A joyful morning for children of all ages: Advent crafts, the story of St Nicholas — the saint behind Father Christmas — and the enthronement of our new Child Bishop.

Each year we choose a Child Bishop, who works with the ministry team to lead prayers and worship at our special festivals through the year. Come and join the fun!
